name: Walking speed
rangeNote: A fitness test, so there is no lab range: your result is compared with people of your age and sex in published norm tables (shown on this page).
summary: How fast you walk at your normal pace over a short, measured distance, in metres per second. It reflects strength, balance and the nervous system working together.

high.meaning: A faster usual walking speed goes with longer survival in people over 65, on average.

low.meaning: A slow usual walking speed in older people goes with higher risk of falls, disability and death on average. It can have many causes; a doctor can look into a slowdown.
commonCauses: A different way of timing the test
